model_xml:
<mujoco model="wall_contact">
  <option
    gravity="0 0 0"
    timestep="0.000125"
    cone="elliptic"
    solver="Newton"
    tolerance="1e-10"
    impratio="10"
    />

  <default>
    <geom friction="0.5 0.005 0.0001" condim="3"/>
  </default>

  <worldbody>
    <light name="top_light" pos="0 0 3" dir="0 0 -1" diffuse="1 1 1"/>

    <!-- Fixed wall: a vertical slab in the x-y plane, standing at x = 2 -->
    <body name="wall" pos="2 0 0">
      <geom name="wall_geom" type="box" size="0.1 5.0 0.2" rgba="0.6 0.6 0.6 1"/>
    </body>

    <!-- Movable object: free to translate in x and y -->
    <body name="object" pos="-1 0 0">
      <joint name="slide_x" type="slide" axis="1 0 0" pos="0 0 0"/>
      <joint name="slide_y" type="slide" axis="0 1 0" pos="0 0 0"/>
      <geom name="object_geom" type="sphere" size="0.15" rgba="0.2 0.4 0.9 1" mass="1.0"/>
    </body>
  </worldbody>

  <actuator>
    <motor name="force_x" joint="slide_x" gear="1"/>
    <motor name="force_y" joint="slide_y" gear="1"/>
  </actuator>
</mujoco>

e1_note: Use post_settle to identify startup exclusion. Keep diagnostics/labels separate from baseline inputs. No automatic cropping on contact loss.
